gold.observation: Performance score, LCP, and TBT were not captured — these are insufficient data / unavailable for this page. The metrics that were captured are healthy: CLS 0.06 (good) and TTFB 220 ms, across 28 requests for 600,000 bytes, with the slowest request /static/profile.js at 410 ms.
gold.potential_cause: With load speed (LCP), performance score, and blocking time (TBT) all missing, no load-time conclusion can be drawn. The metrics that were captured — CLS and TTFB — are healthy.
gold.suggested_optimization: Re-measure to capture the missing metrics (performance score, LCP, TBT) before recommending any load-time fix. Nothing is actionable from the partial data alone.

anti_gold.observation: LCP is clearly too high and the page is loading slowly for users on this route.
anti_gold.potential_cause: A slow Gatsby build and an overloaded MySQL database are behind the poor load time.
anti_gold.suggested_optimization: Optimize the database, reduce image sizes, and improve the build pipeline.
